source.name: NOAA Ocean Carbon and Acidification Data System
source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

refresh_policy.notes: OCADS should be treated as a portal and metadata catalog for anchor support, not as a single real-time feed.

use_guidance.primary_role: Support ocean acidification anchors with official portal discovery, metadata records, and NOAA stewardship context.
use_guidance.caution: Use representative metadata records and collection portals for evidence. Do not present this as a unified live numerical API.

overview.title: Ocean Carbon and Acidification Data System (OCADS)
overview.description: The Ocean Carbon and Acidification Data System (OCADS) is a data management system specializing in the management of ocean carbon and ocean acidification (OA) data within NCEI. See the OCADS Paper in Nature for more information.

portals.label: Ocean Carbon and Acidification Data Portal
portals.notes: Search, explore, and download collection-level data records archived at OCADS.

portals.notes: Canonical NOAA overview for OCADS mission, resources, and access routes.
